content: The task is defined over sequences of symbols, $\lbrace x_1,...x_n | x_i \in X\rbrace $ , where $X$ is the input alphabet. Each symbol $x \in X$ is uniquely associated with its own output alphabet $Y_x$ . Output is created by taking each individual symbol $x_i$ in the sequence and rewriting it as any sequence of $k$ symbols from $Y_{x_i}$ . To do the task, the model must learn alignments between the input and output symbols, and preserve the simple local syntactic conditions (every group of $k$ symbols must come from the same input alphabet $Y_x$ ).
